title: How to Confirm the Windows Device
overview: This article supports the Confirm the Windows Device step in the Computer Running Slowly workflow. It explains how to verify that troubleshooting is being performed on the correct Windows computer, confirm the Windows version, and ensure the technician has access to the appropriate device before making changes.
checklist: Save any open work before beginning troubleshooting.
Confirm the computer name matches the affected device.
Verify the Windows edition and version by opening Settings > System > About.
Confirm you are signed into the intended Windows device and not a remote or secondary computer.
Verify you have administrative access if troubleshooting may require elevated permissions.
Record the Windows version and device name before returning to the workflow.
common_indicators: The reported computer name matches the affected device.
The Windows version has been confirmed.
The technician is connected to the correct computer.
The device information has been documented.
